current_status: Elias investigates the source of the faint Signal, diving deeper into the anomaly.

plot_history.summary: Elias navigates the remnants of a silent world, seeking lost Signals buried within abandoned technology. As he scavenges through decaying stations, he confronts the faded echoes of communication and the relentless Silence.
plot_history.cliffhanger: The Signal grows louder. Shadows linger in the edges of his vision.
